ayuda: Prepare a requirements review or draft list. Check submitted documents and current rules before deciding. Preparation does not submit corrections or publish lists.
seleccion_admision_entrada_invalida: The review could not be prepared. Check the format, references and versions of the supplied material.
seleccion_admision_salida_no_disponible: The result could not be written. Check the destination and prepare it again.
seleccion_admision_causa_fuentes_no_veri: The documents and their connection to the application still need checking.
seleccion_admision_causa_texto_libre: The requirement is expressed as text. Its interpretation needs competent review.
seleccion_admision_causa_regla_ausente: The applicable rule for checking the requirement is missing. Check the selection rules.
seleccion_admision_causa_evaluador_pendi: The proposed rule needs an evaluator accepted under the applicable terms.
seleccion_admision_causa_dato_no_aportad: Data or supporting references are missing for this review.
seleccion_admision_causa_acreditacion_pe: The supplied status or evidence needs verification review.
seleccion_admision_causa_rechazo_aplicab: The supplied rejection needs review of its application to this requirement.
seleccion_admision_causa_vigencia_aplica: The supplied dates do not cover the proposed milestone. Review their application under the applicable terms.
seleccion_admision_accion_preparar_aport: Prepare data or evidence for review
seleccion_admision_accion_preparar_revis: Prepare review of the requirement and its support
seleccion_admision_pendiente_bases_unive: Check the applicable terms and the complete requirement list.
seleccion_admision_pendiente_corresponde: Check correspondence with the application. The local summary remains unsubmitted.
seleccion_admision_pendiente_lectura_aut: Check the required details with the responsible teams.
seleccion_admision_pendiente_identidad_r: Check identity, submission and received documents.
seleccion_admision_pendiente_subsanacion: Determine which items may be corrected and under what conditions before issuing a request.
seleccion_admision_pendiente_aprobacion_: Give reasons for decisions and obtain competent approval before publishing lists.
seleccion_aportacion_admision_entrada_in: The contribution could not be prepared. Check the antecedent, requirement and versions of the proposed support.
seleccion_aportacion_admision_pendiente_: Check the proposal against the requirement and the review of the applicable terms.

seleccion_lista_admision_entrada_invalid: The list could not be prepared. Check that there is one decision per review, that all reviews use the same call rules and that every exclusion has reasons from the catalogue.
seleccion_lista_admision_catalogo_no_dis: The exclusion reasons could not be loaded. Check your selection and try again.
seleccion_lista_admision_pendiente_aprob: The competent body must approve the list before it is published.
seleccion_lista_admision_pendiente_ident: On publication, name, surnames and masked document are added and the list is sorted by surname.
seleccion_lista_admision_pendiente_venci: The last day for corrections is calculated with the calendar from the day after publication.
seleccion_lista_admision_pendiente_publi: Publish the list in the official gazette and on the site set by the call rules.
seleccion_lista_admision_pendiente_catal: The reasons and the deadline are examples. Replace them with the ones HR confirms.
seleccion_lista_definitiva_entrada_inval: The final list could not be prepared. Check the provisional list and ensure each exclusion has a decision.
seleccion_lista_definitiva_pendiente_apr: The competent body must approve the final list before it is published.
seleccion_lista_definitiva_pendiente_reg: Check that every correction or complaint was registered within the deadline.
seleccion_lista_definitiva_pendiente_ide: On publication, name, surnames and masked document are added and the list is sorted by surname.
seleccion_lista_definitiva_pendiente_pub: Publish the final list in the official gazette and on the site set by the call rules.
seleccion_lista_definitiva_pendiente_pie: The decision approving the final list must state the available appeals, the body that hears them and the deadline.
seleccion_revision_lista_entrada_invalid: The new revision could not be prepared. Check that it starts from the previous provisional list, uses the next revision number, keeps its decisions and adds at least one new application.
seleccion_revision_lista_pendiente_plazo: For the added applications, the correction period starts the day after this revision is published.
seleccion_lista_definitiva_pendiente_ult: Check that the provisional list it starts from is the latest published revision.
